title: Network page cards have headers, pills and readable titles

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-21 in the project thread: 'Evolve all these cards and the page design. Give them headers, header pill tags and info. Make sure we can read the title'.

detail:
The Network home (/spaces/the-group/network) drew chapter cards as a logo and a one-line title cut to 'The Group Enc...'. Chapter cards now lead with a cover (gradient fallback), city and event-count pills, the name without the repeated network prefix and wrapping to two lines, a tagline, and the next event. Up next cards get a cover, a date block, host chapter pills, a Going pill, going count and place.

Cards shipped
